summary: Okay the initial shock of being asked to trust the people who spend time commenting on @politico has worn off and I read more: "will be vetted and, if deemed appropriate, added and categorized into our public database of disinformation." Lot of humans involved. That is good.

body_html: Okay the initial shock of being asked to trust the people who spend time commenting on @politico has worn off and I read more: "will be vetted and, if deemed appropriate, added and categorized into our public database of disinformation." Lot of humans involved. That is good.
